advice: Abstain. The supplied NN body already uses one `smstart` and one `smstop` around the full 512³ call. It zeros ZA before each independent output tile; removing those clears would break beta-zero accumulation. The supplied evidence gives no distinct legal change to streaming-region entry, exit, or ZA setup that is likely to help. These are source facts, not measured component costs.
risks: Splitting the call into more streaming regions would add transitions and would measure a broader control-flow change. A useful cost comparison would need full-call measurements with the fixed benchmark and fresh paired controls; component costs cannot be inferred from the supplied disassembly.
